Rae (Design): quick a11y follow-up from today's usability pass: screen readers behave oddly in the topbar search. VoiceOver repeats the label on focus; NVDA doesn't announce highlighted suggestion when arrowing. Theo (Frontend): I can reproduce. DOM currently: + and suggestions rendered as plain
  • elements. Kim (A11y): two issues: ambiguous accessible name (label + aria-label/placeholder) causing double announce, and missing listbox semantics for suggestions. Fixes: make input aria-labelledby to the label (single name) and render suggestions as role="listbox"/role="option" with aria-activedescendant on the input. Keep focus on input. Jules (QA): test cases: on focus VoiceOver should read exactly once e.g. 'Search Redwood Console, edit text'. Arrow down should announce 'Redwood, suggestion 1 of 4' on NVDA and VO. Theo (Frontend): Proposed minimal markup change:
    • Redwood
      • ...
    . Also will add a sr-only span with full name 'Search Redwood Console' for context rather than aria-label. Kim (A11y): good. Also recommend moving live announcements to a polite region that only announces counts, not every keystroke ("4 results"). And for focus visuals bump the focus-visible ring thickness on dark theme to 3px plus subtle shadow; don't rely on color alone. Rae (Design): agree on thicker ring. Keep label visible for sighted users; SR-only provides the extra context. Theo (Frontend): I'll open a small PR with the aria-labelledby/listbox changes + :focus-visible CSS tweak and include VoiceOver/NVDA notes. Jules (QA): I'll add an accessibility regression test and visual snapshot for the focus ring in light/dark themes. bot-deploy: Note: target patch window 2025-04-02 02:00 UTC.
